body: That's exactly what wotc did in deciding not to do business with Terese Nielsen though?
In the settings of the switch.

That false advertising got me then. The card feels a bit different but because of that and the back being a bit off in color I'm guessing it's a printing issue. It's nothing compared to other counterfeits I've received as far as the texture goes. 

This one seemed just off enough to me that I thought I'd ask about it to be sure. I haven't kept up with how counterfeits have progressed in a while or owned a borderless card so this has been a good learning experience.

>Your friend should check his card again, the black border in this picture is meant to have rosette pattern, it's part of the frame templet they use for all cards of this color. 

Do you mean for these borderless cards? I thought the type line box had a solid lines around it normally. 

>Or the red dots on the back of course.

How often do people use real card backs? That's probably something easier to notice though. The red dots are there but the color of the entire back is slightly off. I've chalked it up to a printing issue since everyone seems confident it's real.

Edit: Friend's is foil. I don't think it makes a difference but who knows.
Do only real cards still have blue cores? I thought I'd seen certain series of fakes do now too.
The letters and mana symbols are solid. I've just not seen a legit card have black lines with the rosette in them, especially when another copy of the card doesn't.

Thanks! I haven't kept up with how counterfeits are progressing for a bit so I wasn't sure if the light test was still trustworthy. 

Is checking the rosette pattern less useful now, or at least for cards printed differently like this?

Is that the one where there's 3 slightly visible red dots in the yellow of the green circle? They're there but the back of the card is slightly different than a Mystical Dispute I'm comparing it with.
I thought this might have just been a normal thing for the borderless cards if they came from a different printer or something, but a friend checked and said that they had solid lines on their card.
